M.Eswaramoorthy vs The Collector on 1 June, 2023
The land that belonged to the petitioner was acquired for public purposes.
An award was passed by the Special District Revenue Officer / Land Acquisition Officer in a proceeding dated 31.01.2023.
2.Not satisfied with the award of compensation, the petitioner filed an objection before the District Collector on 30.03.2023.
In respect of such objections, the competent authority/ District Collector has to refer the matter for adjudication before the Court concerned under Section 20 of the Land Acquisition Act.

3.In the present case, the petitioner has submitted the objections by affixing prescribed fee on 30.03.2023 and that being the factum, the District Collector is directed to refer the dispute for adjudication under the provisions of the Act within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. Petitioner is at liberty to adjudicate the issues on merits and in accordance with law before the competent Authority.
5.With these directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.
